title: Modeling Liquid-Cooled Data Centers in EnergyPlus
abstract: arXiv:2610.33148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As AI workloads accelerate data center transition toward high-density racks with direct-to-chip (DTC) liquid cooling, existing simulation tools remain limited in evaluating whole-building and multi-year efficiency. To bridge this gap, we develop a native EnergyPlus object, ElectricEquipment:ITE:LiquidCooled, that models DTC liquid cooling for chilled-water and warm-water architectures as plant-loop components. It couples facility-water loops, rack-side secondary loops, coolant distribution units, and chip-junction temperatures within a single solver. Validation against an independent Modelica implementation across 21 operating conditions, including two full-year runs compared at one-minute resolution, yields loop-temperature RMSE at or below 0.021 K, well within the 0.1 K acceptance threshold. translated_title: 在EnergyPlus中对液冷数据中心进行建模
translated_abstract: 随着AI工作负载加速数据中心向采用芯片级直接液冷（DTC）的高密度机架转型，现有的仿真工具在评估整栋建筑及多年期能效方面仍然存在局限。为弥合这一差距，我们开发了一个原生的EnergyPlus对象ElectricEquipment:ITE:LiquidCooled，将冷冻水架构和温水架构的芯片级直接液冷作为水系统环路组件进行建模。该对象在单一求解器内耦合了设施水环路、机架侧二次环路、冷量分配单元（CDU）以及芯片结温。通过与独立的Modelica实现进行验证，涵盖21种运行工况，其中包括两次以一分钟分辨率对比的全年运行，环路温度的均方根误差（RMSE）不超过0.021 K，远低于0.1 K的验收阈值。我们的案例研究表明，温水液冷可将年度PUE从1.43降至1.25，消除现场用水，并减少总供冷能耗（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文开发了EnergyPlus原生对象ElectricEquipment:ITE:LiquidCooled，可在单一求解器中建模芯片级直接液冷数据中心的完整水系统，经Modelica验证环路温度RMSE不超过0.021 K，案例表明温水液冷可将年度PUE从1.43降至1.25并消除现场用水。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a native EnergyPlus object, ElectricEquipment:ITE:LiquidCooled, that models direct-to-chip liquid-cooled data centers with fully coupled water loops in a single solver, achieves validation accuracy of loop-temperature RMSE ≤ 0.021 K against Modelica, and demonstrates that warm-water liquid cooling reduces annual PUE from 1.43 to 1.25 while eliminating on-site water use.
